newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Dispute at Goldfields mine resolved.
newsitem.headline: Dispute at Goldfields mine resolved.

text.p: Workers and management at a Goldfields of South Africa Ltd mine said on Tuesday they had agreed on dates to make up for lost production and the miners would not be expected to work on New Year's day.

The march planned by the National Union of Mineworkers at 1300 GMT at Libanon gold mine near Johannesburg would continue, but would be used as a report-back session to workers after management conceded their demand, a union spokesman said.
The workers had asked for a day off on December 24 to do Christmas shopping but could not agree with management on the date to make up for the lost day.
"The mine has declared January 1 a public holiday...We had a meeting with the union this morning and advised them it will be a holiday," Libanon mine personnel manager Harvey Berriman told Reuters.
Lost production would be compensated for on January 4 and 11, he added.
Libanon produced 2,028.5 kg of gold in the third quarter of this year compared to 1,973.5 kg in the second quarter.
